title: The Neon Playbook
concept: Four-act workshop musical inside abandoned Studio 404: cobbled devices brought to life by imagination and old variety-show VHS reruns graduate from Neon's crooked 4-note starter hook through duets, a 3-voice canon, and backstage slapstick to a 7-voice polyphonic 'Glow' finale.
styleRules: Pure Studio 404 Found-Object Canon: unmodified vintage hardware & handmade wool felt, real tangled insulated copper electrical wire & Romex cords on Gruff (purple yarn REJECTED), mic-free Tabby + standalone Stage Microphones prop set, Brass Metronome Click (Rattle OUT), and completely separate unconnected comedic duet Tracking (tall 1980s front-loading VHS VCR) & Hertz (squat 1970s olive-cream CRT oscilloscope). Zero cable tether connecting them.

music.linerNotes: D major, 112 BPM, 106 beats (56.79s, swing 0.08, source: songs/neon-playbook.song). Bar 0 is a 4-beat groove intro (0.00-2.14s), then Act I starter hook & Cue scroll flip (2.14-13.93s), Act II Neon/Tabby contrary duet & Watt plug blackout (13.93-27.86s, cf. songs/neon-duet.song), Act III Gruff/Watt/Chip shelf canon & torn-scroll Clank rescue (27.86-41.79s, cf. songs/neon-canon.song), Act IV full polyphonic braid & Hertz booth call (41.79-54.64s), ending on a 4-beat 'Glow' button on degree 7 (54.64-56.79s).

cues.actionNote: do shrug; Neon react laugh; rest 2 freeze

Neon: "Low ring holds the line with me" + Tabby: "High ring climbs in harmony"
Watt: "Watch my cord it pulled too tight" -> [rest 2 blackout 22.50-23.57]
cues.actionNote: do gasp; stage power cut at beat 42
do shrug; Watt react laugh; lights slam back

cues.lyric: Gruff: "Step by step we pass the tune round" + Watt @2 + Chip @4
Cue: "Wait my long paper scroll just tore" -> [rest 2 freeze 36.43-37.50]
Clank: "Wait one beat... I found tape"
Cue: "Hertz says hold the vertical roll" + Neon: "Two bright rings..." -> "Glow" (54.64-56.79)
cues.actionNote: do nod -> full choir D-major 'Glow' hold

shots.motionPrompt: EffectCraft Transform-tween slow push-in (100->104% scale); Thrum plucks XLR cord on beats 1 & 3, Clacker bounces chords on 2 & 4, Click taps reel-case kick & brass tape-reel cymbals (3.2 deg sway, 3-pin Puppet crown lag); singer mouths stay on 'rest' until beat 4 breath.
